sharedRules.name: A talent for Murder
sharedRules.description: When a unit with this targets an enemy unit that is **battleshocked**, **pinned** or has less models then this unit add 1 to the to wound roll. To determine **outnumbering** for **infantry** each model counts as 1 unless it has an ability that cause it to take up more in a transport and instead its value is that. **Terminators** and **Jumppacks** count as 2 unless overwise stated by a rule that makes them take up more transport. **Walkers** count as 5, **Monsters** count as 5 and **vehicles** count as 10.
